spanish: Ceguera o quebrado o hendido o verruga o sarna o tiña, no acercarán estas a Jehová, y ofrenda de fuego no darán desde ellas sobre el altar a Jehová.

findings.issue: Qal passive of H2782 licenses cut, wounded, or maimed; hendido specifies split or cloven.
Common-gender plural demonstrative is feminine estas, which does not cover the masculine items in the list.
H3217 (scurf or scaly eruption) narrowed to tiña (ringworm).

notes: Ceguera, quebrado, verruga, sarna, the two negatives, hiphil acercarán with object, qal darán, ofrenda de fuego, and both a Jehová match the tokens.
